title: LLMFlow Pipeline
description: A declarative YAML pipeline for AI-assisted processing using Scripture Pipelines (sp).

description.description: Optional description of what this pipeline does.

variables.description: Pipeline-level variables available to all steps. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, arrays, or objects.

llm_config.description: Default LLM configuration applied to all llm steps unless overridden.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute.

Step.description: A single pipeline step. The type field selects which step variant applies.

CommonStepFields.description: Fields available on every step type.

name.description: Unique step name within the pipeline. Used in logs, rewind targets, and debug output.

condition.description: Skip this step if the expression is falsy. Supports ${var} references. Example: "${include_detail}".

saveas.description: Write this step's output to disk in addition to storing it in context.

append_to.description: Append this step's output to an existing list variable in context rather than replacing it.

log.description: Override the log level for this step.

retry.description: Retry policy if the step output fails validation.

after.description: Name of a step that must have run before this step (for non-sequential ordering).

LlmStep.description:
Runs a prompt through an LLM and stores the response in context.

flow: once | effect: llm | idempotent: false

model.description: Override the pipeline-level model for this step. Example: "gpt-4o", "claude-3.5-sonnet".

output.description: Context variable to store the LLM response.

output_type.description: Parse the LLM response as JSON before storing. Default: text.

response_format.description: OpenAI structured output schema. Guarantees valid JSON conforming to a declared schema.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens for this step.

max_completion_tokens.description: Alias for max_tokens used by some model families.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the LLM call is abandoned.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for models that support extended thinking.

llm_options.description: Additional LLM provider options passed through directly.

mcp.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server configuration for tool-calling steps.

template.description: Markdown template file to format the LLM response into a final artifact.

FunctionStep.description:
Calls a Python function from the LLMFlow library or custom plugin code.

flow: once | effect: function (arbitrary) | idempotent: unknown

function.description: Dotted Python path to the function. Example: "llmflow.utils.data.parse_bible_reference".

inputs.description: Map of argument name to value or ${expression}. Resolved from context before the function is called.

output.description: Context variable to store the function return value.

ForEachStep.description:
Executes a block of steps once for each element of a list, following XQuery for/in syntax.

  for: scene          (binding variable — the current element)
  in: "${scene_list}" (the list to iterate over)

flow: foreach(in, for) | effect: contains-steps | idempotent: depends

for.description: Name of the loop variable bound to each element. Follows XQuery: for $scene in $list.

in.description: Context variable resolving to the list to iterate over. Follows XQuery: for $scene in $list.

steps.description: Steps to execute for each element.

parallel.description: Number of iterations to run in parallel. Default: 1 (sequential).

group_by.description: Group iterations by this expression before processing.

order_by.description: Sort the list by this expression before iterating.

debug_label.description: Template for per-iteration log labels. Supports ${var} substitution.

WindowStep.description:
Slides a window over a list, executing nested steps for each window.

The start of each window is fixed (position-based). The end is either fixed (size)
or determined dynamically when a nested step emits !window_advance — aligned with
XQuery's 'end when' semantic. Follows XQuery for/in syntax:

  for: window_batch
  in: "${scene_list}"

flow: window(in, for) | effect: contains-steps | idempotent: depends

for.description: Name of the loop variable bound to each window (list of elements). Follows XQuery: for $w in $list.

in.description: Context variable resolving to the list to window over. Follows XQuery: for $w in $list.

size.description: Fixed window size in elements. If omitted, end is determined dynamically by !window_advance.

stride.description: Number of elements to advance after each window. Default: same as size (tumbling). Less than size = sliding.

include_partial.description: Include the final window if it is smaller than size. Default: true.

start_when.description: Expression evaluated on each element to determine window start. Aligns with XQuery 'start when'.

end_when.description: Expression evaluated during processing to determine window end. Aligns with XQuery 'end when'. Alternative to !window_advance.

size_by_tokens.description: Token-based window size. Requires model to be set for tokenisation.

model.description: Model used for token counting when size_by_tokens is set.

steps.description: Steps to execute for each window.

IfStep.description:
Conditionally executes a block of steps.

flow: conditional(condition) | effect: contains-steps | idempotent: depends

condition.description: Expression evaluated before the block runs. If falsy, the block is skipped. Supports ${var} references.

steps.description: Steps to execute when condition is truthy.

JsonStep.description:
Assembles a structured value from context variables and stores it in context. No I/O.

flow: once | effect: pure | idempotent: true

value.description: The value to store. May be a scalar, map, or list. Strings support ${var} substitution.

output.description: Context variable to store the assembled value.

SaveStep.description:
Writes content to a file. Terminal step — produces no context variable.
Use saveas on another step to write output to disk while also storing it in context.

flow: once | effect: file-write | idempotent: true

path.description: Output file path. Supports ${var} substitution. Parent directories are created automatically.

LoadJsonStep.description:
Loads a JSON file into context as a dict or list. Use key: to extract a nested value by dot-path.

flow: once | effect: file-read | idempotent: true

key.description: Dot-path to extract from the loaded data. Example: "pericopes" or "book.chapters". Raises an error if the path does not exist.

LoadYamlStep.description:
Loads a YAML file into context as a dict or list. Use key: to extract a nested value by dot-path.

flow: once | effect: file-read | idempotent: true

key.description: Dot-path to extract from the loaded data. Example: "pericopes" or "book.chapters". Raises an error if the path does not exist.

LoadXmlStep.description:
Loads an XML file into context. Without xpath:, returns the root lxml.etree._Element. With xpath:, returns a list of matching nodes in the requested output_format.

flow: once | effect: file-read | idempotent: true

xpath.description: XPath expression to apply to the root element. Supports ${var} substitution. Returns a list of matching nodes.

namespaces.description: Namespace prefix-to-URI mapping for namespace-aware XPath. Example: {"usx": "http://usx.org/"}.

output_format.description: How to serialize XPath results. element: lxml _Element objects (default). xml-string: serialized XML strings. text: text content of each node.

LoadCsvStep.description:
Loads a CSV file into context as a list of dicts (one dict per row, keys from header).
Supports where/limit/offset/columns filtering.

flow: once | effect: file-read | idempotent: true

where.description: Filter expression applied after loading. Supports ${var} substitution. Forms (joined by 'and'): column == 'value' | column startswith 'prefix' | book/chapter/verse/word(column) == 'value'.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, applied after where filter.

offset.description: Rows to skip, applied after where filter.

columns.description: Column names to include. If omitted, all columns are returned.

LoadTsvStep.description:
Loads a TSV file into context as a list of dicts (one dict per row, keys from header).
Supports where/limit/offset/columns filtering.

flow: once | effect: file-read | idempotent: true

where.description: Filter expression applied after loading. Supports ${var} substitution. Forms (joined by 'and'): column == 'value' | column startswith 'prefix' | book/chapter/verse/word(column) == 'value'.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, applied after where filter.

offset.description: Rows to skip, applied after where filter.

columns.description: Column names to include. If omitted, all columns are returned.

LoadTextStep.description:
Loads a text or Markdown file into context as a string.

flow: once | effect: file-read | idempotent: true

LoadDirectoryStep.description:
Loads all files matching a glob pattern from a directory into a list. Files are parsed per format and returned in sorted filename order.

flow: once | effect: file-read | idempotent: true

pattern.description: Glob pattern relative to path. Example: "*.json", "*.md".

format.description: How to parse each matched file.

BasexStep.description:
Runs an XQuery against a local BaseX database via the basex CLI.

flow: once | effect: db | idempotent: true

query_file.description: Path to an .xq XQuery file. Exactly one of query_file or query is required.

query.description: Inline XQuery expression. Exactly one of query_file or query is required.

inputs.description: Map of XQuery external variable name to ${expression}. Resolved from context and substituted into the query.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the BaseX process is killed. Default: 120.

DuckdbStep.description:
Runs a SQL query via DuckDB and stores the result in context.

flow: once | effect: db | idempotent: true

query_file.description: Path to a .sql file. Exactly one of query or query_file is required.

inputs.description: Map of context variable name to context key. Registers context values as DuckDB tables or parameters.

format.description: Output format. records = list of dicts. Default: records.

PluginStep.description: A registered plugin step type (xpath, xslt, tsv, or user-installed plugins). The type field must match a registered plugin name. All additional fields are passed to the plugin function.

type.description: Registered plugin name. Built-in: xpath, xslt, tsv.

PromptConfig.description: Prompt configuration for an llm step. The prompt always lives in a file: there is no inline form. Keys here must match what render_prompt() in steps/llm.py reads (LLMFlow#197).

file.description: Path to a .gpt prompt file. Relative to the pipeline file.

inputs.description: Map of prompt variable name to value or ${expression}. Must satisfy the prompt file's requires: contract.

LlmConfig.description: Default LLM settings applied pipeline-wide. Individual steps may override.

timeout_seconds.description: Default LLM call timeout in seconds.

LinterConfig.description: Controls linting behaviour for this pipeline.

warnings_as_errors.description: Treat linter warnings as errors. Default: false.

RetryConfig.description: Retry policy for a step. The step is re-run if the output fails any declared constraint.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts including the first. Default: 3.

min_length.description: Retry if the output is shorter than this many characters.

max_length.description: Retry if the output is longer than this many characters.

must_contain.description: Retry if the output does not contain this string or any string in this list.

backoff_seconds.description: Seconds to wait between attempts. Default: 0.

SaveasValue.description: Write output to disk. A path string, a config object, or a list of config objects for multiple files.

oneOf.description: File path. Supports ${var} substitution. Format is auto-detected from extension.
Multiple output files from a single step.

content.description: Content to write. Supports ${var} substitution. Defaults to the step's output.

format.description: Output format. Default: auto-detected from file extension.

ResponseFormatConfig.description: OpenAI structured output configuration. Guarantees valid JSON conforming to a JSON Schema.

type.description: json_schema: enforce full schema (recommended). json_object: force JSON but no schema validation.

json_schema.description: Schema definition. Only used when type is json_schema.

strict.description: Require strict schema adherence. Recommended: true.

schema.description: JSON Schema definition of the expected response structure.

LoadPath.description: File path. Supports ${var} substitution. Static paths are checked for existence at lint time; paths containing ${...} are checked at runtime.

OutputField.description: Context variable name to store the result. Use output (singular).
